kiwi.name: Kiwi
kiwi.summary: Our fresh Iranian Kiwis are carefully selected for their vibrant green flesh, juicy texture, and naturally balanced sweet-tart flavour. Sourced from trusted growers in Iran, they are handled with care to preserve their freshness and quality. Perfect for enjoying fresh, adding to fruit bowls and salads, or blending into refreshing smoothies.

availability.label: Seasonal
availability.note: ( Typically available from November to February )

kiwi.bestFor: Fresh eating, fruit bowls, salads & smoothies

hero.alt: A whole kiwi beside a cut kiwi

benefits.title: Health Benefits of Kiwi
benefits.body: Kiwi is a nutrient-rich fruit packed with vitamin C, dietary fibre, antioxidants, potassium, and other essential nutrients. Its high vitamin C content helps support the body's natural immune function and protects cells from oxidative stress. The dietary fibre in kiwi promotes healthy digestion and can support regular bowel movements, while its natural enzymes may also help with the digestion of proteins. Kiwi provides potassium, which contributes to normal muscle and nerve function, and its high water content makes it a refreshing addition to a balanced diet. With its combination of nutrients, antioxidants, fibre, and natural freshness, kiwi is a healthy choice for everyday consumption.

image.alt: Bowl of sliced kiwi labeled with vitamin C, dietary fiber, antioxidants, and potassium

season.title: Availability
season.body: Kiwi is a seasonal fruit, with availability depending on the growing and harvesting season in its country of origin. Our Iranian kiwis are generally available from late autumn through winter, with peak availability typically during November to February. Availability may vary slightly each year based on harvest conditions, crop quality, and supply.

cherry.name: Cherry
cherry.summary: Our fresh cherries are chosen for their deep colour, firm bite, and bright sweet flavour. Sourced from trusted growers, they are packed with care so they arrive ready for fresh snacking and seasonal displays.

availability.label: Seasonal
availability.note: ( Typically available from May to August )

benefits.title: Health Benefits of Cherry
benefits.body: Cherries bring natural sweetness with vitamin C, fibre, and antioxidants. Enjoyed fresh, they are a refreshing seasonal fruit for everyday snacking and for adding colour to fruit bowls.

season.title: Availability
season.body: Cherries are a seasonal fruit. Availability follows the harvest in the country of origin and can shift slightly each year with crop conditions and supply.

apple.name: Red Apple
apple.summary: Our red apples are selected for their crisp bite, balanced sweetness, and reliable quality. Grown with care and handled to stay fresh, they suit everyday eating, fruit bowls, and retail displays.

availability.label: Seasonal
availability.note: ( Typically available from September to March )

benefits.title: Health Benefits of Red Apple
benefits.body: Red apples are a familiar everyday fruit with fibre, vitamin C, and natural freshness. Their crisp texture makes them an easy choice for snacking and for fresh fruit displays.

season.title: Availability
season.body: Red apples follow the harvest season in their growing region. Peak supply is typically through autumn and winter, and availability can vary with crop quality and demand.

apricot.name: Apricot
apricot.summary: Our apricots are chosen for their golden colour, soft aroma, and sweet-tart taste. They are handled carefully from harvest so the fruit stays fresh for eating and seasonal displays.

availability.label: Seasonal
availability.note: ( Typically available from May to July )

benefits.title: Health Benefits of Apricot
benefits.body: Apricots offer a juicy seasonal bite with fibre, vitamin C, and natural sweetness. They work well eaten fresh or added to fruit salads and desserts.

season.title: Availability
season.body: Apricots have a short seasonal window. Supply depends on the harvest in the country of origin and can vary year to year with growing conditions.

orange.name: Orange
orange.summary: Our oranges are selected for their bright colour, juicy segments, and lively citrus flavour. Sourced from trusted growers, they are packed to keep their freshness for juicing and fresh eating.

availability.label: Seasonal
availability.note: ( Typically available from June to October )

benefits.title: Health Benefits of Orange
benefits.body: Oranges are known for vitamin C, a juicy texture, and a fresh citrus taste. They are an easy everyday fruit for juicing, snacking, and fruit displays.

season.title: Availability
season.body: Oranges follow the harvest season of their growing region. Peak months depend on origin, and supply can shift slightly with crop conditions each year.
